precedents.title: Receipt-processing chain: taxi expense settlement
precedents.abstract: A four-skill automation chain removes manual entry from receipt photos via OCR, JSON handoffs, and browser automation with SSO profile reuse. One human checkpoint remains at structured-data confirmation.

precedents.title: Reconciliation chain: CRM opportunity sync to Excel
precedents.abstract: A four-skill automation chain removes manual CRM field transcription into Excel via DOM extraction, Shadow DOM traversal, SSO profile reuse, and weekly summary regeneration.
